purpose: Operational strategy-research close-at-high predicate, not an official absolute limit-up price reconstruction
return: (raw close T / raw close at preceding valid trading observation - 1) * 100
price_comparison: Decimal(str(raw DOUBLE)) validated on 0.01-CNY tick; exact equality, no tolerance
special_phase: IPO first five, relisting first day, delisting-arrangement first day and qualified no-limit exceptions are excluded
reference_special: D5 factor change or ex-right screen requires qualified raw exchange reference; otherwise UNRESOLVED
special_exception: Independent day evidence must clear other no-limit exceptions before TRUE; UNKNOWN is UNRESOLVED
v1_relation: IS_CLOSE_LIMIT_UP_V1 remains unchanged and has different official-absolute semantics
